summary: Iteration 5 fully validated: Emergent badge/posthog removed sitewide; admin Branding + Features tabs work; category/product image upload data-testids present; 2MB hint & URL fallback removed; product unit selector with Bengali presets + __custom__ works; product cards use bg-transparent+object-contain; site feature flags conditionally hide home-track-card & newsletter and are restored ON; Track/Checkout PDF links have no target='_blank'; guest checkout + public tracking still work.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx is ~350 lines and contains 5 forms – consider splitting into tab-specific components (BrandingTab, FeaturesTab, PaymentTab, etc.) for maintainability.
Logo data URLs stored in MongoDB grow quickly; consider adding a size cap server-side (e.g., reject > 500KB base64) and/or migrate to an /uploads endpoint with static hosting for large images.

SiteContext fetches once on mount but does not refresh after admin updates settings – admin changes require a hard reload to see brand color/logo update on already-mounted pages. Acceptable for now but noted.
seed_data_creation: Created one guest test order (TEST_Guest, 01700000000) during regression check via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py. Feature toggles were toggled off then restored to ON; brand color/logo restored to defaults. All P0 items requested by the review passed.
